reviews.review:
So, I've been playing this game for a while now and finnally thought I should review it. Lets get right into it shall we?

First off, lemme just say that this game, for being free, is really well optimized at least for my and my friend's rigs. The graphics overall as well are REALLY nice especially being a free game. I know that there are some other free games that have amazing graphics but this one (atleast for me) takes the cake. Now there have been some graphical glitches I've ran into but they're usually pretty minor. Speaking of glitches, this game MOST DEFINITLY has its fair share lemme tell ya. However, most of them usually get patched out the next hotfix so it's not that bad. There are also some hilarious ones so thats always a good laugh. As far as gameplay goes, this game wins it for me as well. The time and care that DE puts into each frame is amazing. Each frame is unique, has its own style and abilities. Even further from that the amount of weapons added into this mix makes it that much better. Then when you add in the mods, it makes the list of customization and amount of playstyles so much longer.

Now for the few cons:
Platinum. Need I say more? Well actually, I don't really have an issue with plat it's just expensive and I'm poor (from buying plat fml) Only reason I'm okay with it is because it supports the constant updates (and by constant I mean almost weekly). 
Wait time. Theres a lot of it. Just get ready to wait for stuff you want. On average it takes most weapons 12-24 hours to make, warframe parts take 12 and the warframe takes a whopping 73 hours to craft. It's not bad persay but I still find it annoying even if it is to balence the game. 

Other than this I cant really think of any other personal complaints I have with the game, really. Overall I would highly recommend this game to someone that likes PvE with some PvP games (sorta like Destiny I guess?) It's really a great game to sit down witha few friends and play the hell outta for an hour or two.
